Step the mesher

Source: R/lari.R
lari_step.Rd

Insert up to n refinement points with CGAL's step-by-step mesher, using the criteria from the last lari_refine() call. After an edit the mesher is rebuilt on the edited mesh, so stepping refines only what the edit spoiled.

Usage

lari_step(m, n = 1L)

Arguments

m

a mesh from lari_new()

n

maximum number of new vertices

Value

the number of vertices inserted

Examples

m <- lari_new(c(0, 1, 1, 0), c(0, 0, 1, 1), 1:4, c(2, 3, 4, 1))
lari_refine(m, max_area = 0.01, max_steiner = 0)
lari_step(m, 5)
#> [1] 5
lari_counts(m)$steiner
#> [1] 5
